logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Two-panel analytical illustration for the WO-05 depot charger decision brief. Left panel: horizontal bar chart of measured energy on a stated 0–70 kWh axis with gridlines every 10 kWh; bars P2 = 15, P3 = 24, P1 = 44, P4 = 64 kWh, drawn strictly proportional (stated scale 8 px per kWh), with P2 highlighted in the accent blue and value labels at each bar end. Right panel: five-step gate-screening workflow — trusted source table; quality gate at 80 (all four pass); defect gate at 5 (all pass, P4 exactly at limit); lowest energy among qualifiers selects P2 at 15 kWh; recommendation P2 with independent verification and handover. Footer note states the common output/load/acceptance-test basis and the leader gaps +9, +29, +49 kWh. All values come from the trusted table only; no decorative or symbolic elements.
